statement: SDL3.2.10 marks a non-MotionPlus extension-presence change disconnected, removes the joystick and requests a rescan. For an otherwise still-enumerated standalone Wii HID device, the rescan does not delete/re-add it while device->dev stays open. The generic joystick-close wrapper and Wii close/free callbacks do not close that handle. Therefore this path does not reattach the joystick on an unchanged still-present hidraw device. This is a source-derived consumer limitation consistent with W2/W3, not a virtualgamepad protocol defect or physical observation. Full SDL quit, device removal or driver reinitialization is outside this claim.

applicability.revision: SDL consumer source; physical Wii revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. 877399b: Wii HandleStatus1350-1384, UpdateDevice1512-1576, CloseJoystick1579-1587, FreeDevice1589-1591; generic HIDAPI_JoystickDisconnected762-800, rescan1071-1149 (predicate1118-1119), JoystickClose1626-1657. Conditional on device staying enumerated, driver enabled and open handle retained.
